name: agent-status
description: A mod that adds a live-agent count by status and task done/total above the prompt, with an `agents` pane giving each agent's model, time in status and time since spawn, which the built-in agent panel lacks.

enabled.title: Enable the mod
enabled.description: Off removes the agent count line above the prompt and the agents pane. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session. Only an exact false turns it off.

pollSeconds.title: Agent list refresh (seconds)
pollSeconds.description: How often the agent list is re-read while nothing else triggers a refresh (a spawn or Task call always refreshes at once). Whole seconds, 1 to 60. Takes effect after a reload or in a new session.
